purpose: Verify CFL-controlled SSP-RK3 time advancement of the three quasi-one-dimensional flow equations when a source-backed H2/C2H4 composition field is prescribed and held fixed during all RK stages, before allowing phi/eta/composition to evolve with the flow.
implemented: one-step SSP-RK3 wrapper using the P11.3F variable-composition quasi-1D Rusanov RHS
scientific_boundaries: The composition field is immutable during the entire transient; this is not yet dynamic combustion closure coupling.
No species-transport PDE or conservative species flux is added.
No fuel injection, wall friction, wall heat transfer, or teacher reaction update is connected in this stage.
No independent teacher chemical Qdot source is added; chemical energy remains embedded in absolute composition-dependent species energy.
Rusanov and transmissive boundaries remain compatibility choices; teacher variable-composition Steger-Warming and final inlet/outlet semantics remain pending.
next_step: Define and verify the dynamic algebraic update contract that maps source-backed fuel/air flow, injection location, mixing efficiency and combustion efficiency into phi(x), eta(x), and Y_i(x) without chemical-energy double counting, before coupling wall/fuel sources into a formal teacher case.
